title: Ukrainian Apple Pie
description: A traditional Ukrainian-style apple pie with a flaky pastry crust, perfect for a cozy dessert.

ingredients.name: Apples (2 cups, sliced)
ingredients.notes: Any variety of apple, but Granny Smith works well

instructions: Roll out the pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Transfer the dough to a 9-inch pie dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together the sliced apples, granulated sugar, cinnamon, lemon zest, and lemon juice.
Fill the pie crust with the apple mixture and dot the top with the beaten egg.
Roll out the remaining pastry dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch.
Use a pastry cutter or a knife to create a decorative border.
Place the border on top of the pie and crimp the edges to seal.
Cut a few slits in the top crust to allow steam to escape.
Brush the top crust with the melted butter and sprinkle with water.
Bake the pie for 45-50 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes before serving.
